architecture: baseline-native environment -> raw SMILES -> shared evaluator pinned to production RDKit 2024.3.5 -> canonical key + validity + oracle score. Baselines are NOT forced into one environment; that breaks the old implementations. Canonicalization and scoring happen exactly once, under the pin, so unique_valid_canonical_evaluations is comparable across methods.
title: SHARED EVALUATOR VALIDATION — pinned RDKit 2024.3.5
